notes: The catalog text ends mid-sentence in the A.A. in Sociology description ('Students can gain valuable tools in d'), before its Degree Requirements, total, outcomes and career information. No blocks, total, outcomes or careers could be recorded; the reviewer should fetch page 634 of the PDF.

The A.A. in Sociology description is identical so far to the A.A.-T description, which goes on to name career fields (community planning and development, education, law and law enforcement, profit and non-profit sectors, social work); these were not recorded because that sentence is not printed in the A.A. section's extracted text.
The A.A.-T in Sociology (18-19 units), A.A. in Intercultural Studies (26 units) and A.A. in Social Work and Community Studies (21 units) sections were not used, as they belong to other awards.
